The audible frequency is the difference between them. Volume is controlled by a second antenna. Modern versions use capacitive sensing, ultrasonic distance, or optical tracking. Continuous pitch control teaches intonation that discrete keyboards cannot — mistakes are heard as glides, correctable in real time.

th_pitch.name: Hand Distance from Pitch Antenna
th_pitch.instruction: Your right hand position determines the pitch. Roll.

th_vol.name: Hand Distance from Volume Antenna
th_vol.instruction: Your left hand controls volume. Roll — how far from the arc?

poly.title: The Voice Colony

npcQuote.name: Wendy Carlos
npcQuote.text: The synthesizer was monophonic for years, and we used the limitation as a feature. The day polyphony arrived, everything sounded thinner — because we had been making the single voice work so hard.

lore: A monophonic synthesizer plays one note at a time. A polyphonic synthesizer allocates multiple voices — copies of the same signal chain — assigning incoming notes to available voices. The challenge is voice allocation: when all voices are occupied, voice stealing assigns the quietest or oldest voice to the new note.

The Polyphonic Hive is a colony of identical creatures that have learned to harmonise. Each member is identical in architecture. But they never play the same pitch — they negotiate, in real time, without a conductor. The Hive is distributed polyphony: leaderless, self-organising, capable of chords.
{hunter}: polyphony is an organisational problem disguised as a musical one. How many voices, how detuned, how allocated — engineering questions with aesthetic consequences.
victoryLore: The Hive assigns {hunter} a voice and the colony stabilises.
Polyphony unlocked. Multiple simultaneous voices — chords, harmonics, unison layering — are yours to architect.
poly.victoryTheory: Polyphonic synthesis assigns one complete signal chain per simultaneous note. Voice allocation: low-note, high-note, last-note, or round-robin priority. Unison mode stacks all voices on the same note with slight detuning for width. Detune amount controls the beating frequency between voices. The Juno-106 (6 voices), Oberheim Matrix-12 (12 voices), and Korg M1 (16 voices) each defined an era.

py_v.name: The Colony's Voice Count
py_v.instruction: How many voices speak simultaneously? Roll.

py_d.name: The Colony's Detuning
py_d.instruction: How much do the voices drift from unison? Roll.

chord.title: The Harmonic Archive

npcQuote.name: Klaus Schulze
npcQuote.text: A chord is not three notes. It is one sound with texture. The synthesizer taught me that what I thought was harmony was actually timbre — that the chord and the waveform are the same phenomenon at different scales.

lore: A chord is multiple frequencies sounding simultaneously. A waveform is also multiple frequencies sounding simultaneously — its harmonics. The difference is one of scale. Play a chord fast enough and it becomes a timbre. Slow a timbre down and it becomes a chord.

The Harmonic Construct is architecture built from stacked resonant chambers — each tuned to a different interval above a common root. When a sound is played through it, specific frequencies are amplified and others absorbed. The sound that emerges has acquired the harmony of the building itself.
{hunter}: name the root. Name the quality. The Construct demonstrates that harmony and timbre are one phenomenon.
victoryLore: The Construct accepts {hunter}'s root and quality, and the intervals ring.
Chord synthesis unlocked — simultaneous intervals, harmonic stacking, the relationship between waveform and chord as expressions of the same mathematics.
chord.victoryTheory: Chord synthesis stacks oscillators at interval ratios above a root. Major chord: 1, 5/4, 3/2 (root, major third, fifth). Minor: 1, 6/5, 3/2. These ratios align with the harmonic series — why chords sound consonant. Dissonance is misalignment with the harmonic series. Chord modules generate intervals internally from a single pitch input, allowing monophonic playing with harmonic output.

ch_root.name: The Harmonic Root
ch_root.instruction: Which pitch anchors the construct? Roll.

morph.title: The Form Archive

npcQuote.name: Suzanne Ciani
npcQuote.text: The Buchla's waveform control was a dial between two voices. I spent years exploring what lived between them. Between a sine and a sawtooth there is not emptiness — there is every other instrument.

lore: Wavetable synthesis stores multiple waveforms in a table and sweeps through them continuously. The position in the wavetable determines which waveform plays, or what interpolation between adjacent waveforms plays. At position 0: sine. At position 127: sawtooth. At position 64: the crossfade between them — a shape that has existed in mathematics but has never been named.

The Shape Between inhabits every position between two extremes. It was neither the first shape nor the last — it is the interpolation, the gradient, the passage. In Moogham it occupies a district of things that exist between categories: half-built structures, half-completed rituals.
{hunter}: morph controls the waveform position. The sound is always in transition — always becoming more or less of what it started as.
victoryLore: The Shape Between settles at {hunter}'s chosen morphing position.
Wavetable morphing unlocked — continuous waveform crossfading controlled by CV, allowing timbral motion no single waveform can produce.
morph.victoryTheory: Wavetable synthesis stores single-cycle waveforms in an array. A position parameter (0–127) selects between them with interpolation at fractional positions. The position can be modulated by LFO, envelope, or any CV — creating timbral animation. PPG Wave (1981) pioneered it; Serum popularised it. The waveform can evolve in sync with the envelope (bright attack, dark sustain) or LFO (oscillating between two timbres).

mo_wave.name: The Starting Form
mo_wave.instruction: Where on the morphing axis do you begin? Roll.

mo_fold.name: The Morph Depth
mo_fold.instruction: How far across the wavetable does the morph sweep? Roll.

lissajous.title: The Lissajous Observatory

npcQuote.name: Jules Antoine Lissajous
npcQuote.text: When two vibrations act together, they trace their relationship in space. The figure is a signature — the signature of proportion. Every ratio has its own geometry.

lore: A Lissajous figure is the XY graph of two oscillators — one horizontal, one vertical. When the frequencies are in a simple integer ratio, the figure is a stable closed curve: a circle, a figure-eight, a bowtie. When the ratio is irrational, the figure never closes and fills the screen gradually, never repeating.

The Pattern Eater arrived in the Observatory before the first oscilloscope did. The observatory's primary lens projects the pattern onto a wall. Hunters who enter cannot stop watching — the figure is hypnotic because it is both predictable (mathematics) and surprising (the figure reveals the relationship between two numbers).
{hunter}: set the X frequency. Set the Y. The ratio between them is the figure. The pattern is already implicit in the numbers.
victoryLore: The Pattern Eater's figure stabilises at {hunter}'s chosen ratio.
Lissajous synthesis unlocked — XY oscilloscope art as synthesis technique, frequency relationships made geometric.
lissajous.victoryTheory: A Lissajous figure plots two oscillators on XY axes. 1:1 = circle/line (depending on phase). 1:2 = figure-eight. 2:3 = three-lobed figure. The shape reveals frequency ratio and phase relationship. In synthesis, Lissajous patterns are generated by ring modulating two oscillators. Oscilloscope mode shows the pattern to reveal tuning: when oscillators are in harmonic ratio, the figure snaps to a stable, closed shape.

li_ratio.name: The X:Y Frequency Ratio
li_ratio.instruction: Set the ratio. The figure is already in the numbers. Roll.

li_phase.name: The Phase Relationship
li_phase.instruction: The phase rotates the figure. Roll.

affect.title: The Affective Resonance

npcQuote.name: Laurie Anderson
npcQuote.text: The instrument does not feel. But when you play it correctly, something feels through it. I don't know where that happens. I know that it does.

lore: Affect in music theory refers to the emotional quality that a piece communicates — not by describing an emotion linguistically but by evoking it through timbre, rhythm, space, and gesture. The synthesizer does not feel. Its parameters are numbers. But the right combination of numbers consistently produces the same affective response in listeners.

The Affect Specter moves through Moogham according to the emotional needs of whatever moment is current. When the city is grieving, it settles in the lower registers, long attacks, high reverb. When frightened, it compresses frequency range and shortens all decays. It does not decide to be in a place. It is wherever the affect is.
{hunter}: the parameters you have been setting all along were never neutral. Every roll you have made has been an affective choice.
victoryLore: The Affect Specter settles into {hunter}'s chosen emotional register.
Affect synthesis unlocked — the deliberate use of timbre, envelope, and space to produce specific emotional responses. The vocabulary is now also an expressive language.
affect.victoryTheory: Affective synthesis: choosing parameters for emotional impact rather than technical correctness. Reliable correlations: high attack = aggression or surprise; long release = melancholy; high Q = anxiety; low frequencies + slow modulation = gravitas or dread; bright waveform + high formant = joy or alarm. These are tendencies shaped by culture and context. The synthesizer is the most direct instrument for testing them: a parameter change is immediate, isolated, and audible.

af_vowel.name: The Affective Vowel
af_vowel.instruction: Which formant cluster carries the emotional quality? Roll.

af_atk.name: The Emotional Attack
af_atk.instruction: How does the affect arrive? Roll.

microcosm.title: The Pthumerian Core

npcQuote.name: Karlheinz Stockhausen
npcQuote.text: The universe is a synthesizer. I am not being metaphorical. The universe oscillates at every frequency simultaneously. What we call music is the part of that spectrum we have chosen to attend to.

lore: Beneath Moogham — beneath the Resonant Void, beneath the Cathedral Chambers, beneath the Attractor Fields — there is a point the old cartographers called the Pthumerian Core. They drew it as a dot and wrote next to it: *"Do not seek to describe what is here. The description would require a language we have not invented."*

Micr0c0sm is not a creature. It is a process — the synthesis of every process you have encountered. All oscillators, all filters, all modulators, all effects, all sequencers simultaneously. It is not large. It is dense. It generates its own sound continuously. It has never stopped. It predates the city.

The only path through the Core is through what you know. Every encounter you survived has given you a piece of the language the cartographers said did not exist. {hunter} — you have built it. Every roll, every cable, every parameter. You carry the whole system now.
Listen. All of it is here.
victoryLore: Micr0c0sm resolves.

Not into silence — into something that sounds like all the encounters simultaneously. Then it simplifies, until only the tone you first learned in the Moogham Underbelly remains: 220 Hz. The Singing Wound's note. The beginning.

{hunter}: the synthesis of synthesis is the original oscillator. Everything you learned between the first tone and this one was the long way around to the same note — heard, this time, with forty-one more dimensions of understanding.
You are not a hunter. You have not been a hunter for a long time. You are a composer of the frequency that contains all other frequencies.
Moogham will always be here. So will the sound. So will you.
microcosm.victoryTheory:
The complete synthesis vocabulary: VCO → VCF → ADSR → LFO → Reverb/Delay/Chorus/Phaser/Tape → Sequencer/Turing/Drunk/Euclid/Sidechain → Wavefolder/Ring Mod/Noise/Formant/Ladder → Flanger/Bitcrusher/Spectral/Resonator/FM → Arpeggio/Quantize/Clock/Chaos/S&H → Attenuverter/Mixer/XY/Theremin/Poly/Chord/Morph/Lissajous/Affect.

These are not separate tools. They are one system with many entry points. The synthesizer is one instrument. You have learned all of it.
